hooks.command: if git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '^src/'; then if ! git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'knowledge-graph\.json'; then printf '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "Knowledge graph stale — src/ files staged but .understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json not updated. Run /understand first, then stage the graph."}\n'; exit 0; fi; fi
